description.to:
Outcome: What must be true: a vote, rating, comment, flag or submission is recorded for the tenant whose host served the page. The reader API (CMS routes /api/reader/* then the reader-actions function) resolves the tenant from the request's Origin/Host through TenantDomain, refuses an Origin that is not an active tenant host, and ignores any tenant named in the body. Reader rows carry the tenant (PPY-ef2c57); per-reader rate counters are per tenant.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): app/api/reader/*, amplify/plugins/reader-steering/function, TenantDomain lookup, docs/reader-steering.md.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/reader-writes-tenant-from-host.feature):
Scenario: A vote is recorded for the site it was cast on
    Given a reader on "alpha.apyr.us"
    When the browser sends a vote whose body names "beta"
    Then the vote is recorded for "alpha" only

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-ef2c57, PPY-3bbbf9. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-57f6d2.

Testing: Behave; adversarial suite reader cases.
Rollout: Shared stack, when reader features are enabled for tenants (M7).
Risk and mitigation: Risk: Origin can be absent from some requests. Mitigation: refuse writes without a matching Origin, as today's Origin check does.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
